frames.headline: When the pattern is there, it says so.
frames.subline: Read against 5-1-1, 4-1-1 or 3-1-1 — whichever guideline your provider gave you.

frames.headline: Start when it begins. End when it eases.
frames.subline: The whole lower half of the screen is the button. Made for a dark room and one hand.

frames.headline: Opens on the button.
frames.subline: No quiz, no sign-up, no walkthrough between you and a contraction that has already started.

frames.headline: It won’t guess.
frames.subline: No figure appears until enough is timed to mean something. An em dash, never a zero.

frames.headline: Start and stop from the Lock Screen.
frames.subline: Without unlocking, without finding the app. The count keeps ticking where you can see it.

frames.headline: Every stretch, kept on your phone.
frames.subline: Each episode with its own averages. Undo a wrong tap. Nothing leaves the device.

frames.headline: Their guideline, their number, one tap away.
frames.subline: Set the rule they gave you and the call is a tap, not a search through Contacts at 3am.
